role: Normalizes STIX and MISP threat feed data already in hand into a single common indicator shape, so downstream bots and reviewers don't need to understand multiple external threat-intel formats.
behaviorDescription: normalizeStixBundle() parses 'indicator' objects from a STIX 2.1 bundle, extracting the simple single-comparison pattern shape ([object-type:property = 'value']) only — compound/boolean patterns and unsupported operators are skipped and reported, never guessed at. normalizeMispEvent() parses a MISP event's Attribute array the same way, skipping and reporting any attribute missing type or value. Both record a Decision and signal the swarm when indicators are found. fetchTaxiiCollection() is an honest stub: it throws a clear error, because this repo has no TAXII 2.x client and no credentialed or mock server to verify a real HTTP round-trip against.
hardStops: Never fetches from a live network source — only normalizes data already provided to it
Never guesses at a STIX pattern it cannot confidently parse — unparseable patterns are skipped and reported, not silently dropped or misinterpreted
fetchTaxiiCollection() never fakes a network response — it throws until a real TAXII client exists
